_comment: The main mystery (scripts/world/mystery.gd). After midnight the unlisted station on the radio reads out a place; drive there between midnight and half past three and something is waiting. Each clue needs the career tier `tier` (0-based) and comes at least `min_days` days after the last one. `spot` is a photo spot id from data/world/places.json, or "lane_end" for the far end of Little Shenton Lane; `at` [x, y, z] is where the thing waits, on the kerb or footpath by that spot (without it, 3 m to the side of the photo spot). `broadcast` is what the voice says; `found` is shown when you pick it up; `cupboard` is the prop that turns up in the cupboard under the stairs the next morning (cassette, polaroid, ticket, map, keyring). The last clue is the shed key.

clues.broadcast: "...Fraser Avenue. The gums are white tonight. I left it on the kerb, under the third lamp..."
clues.found: A cassette on the kerb, dry despite the dew. The label says NIGHT DRIVE 1 in neat capitals.
clues.title: the NIGHT DRIVE 1 tape

clues.broadcast: "...Mounts Bay Road, under the scarp. Where the water's closest. Stop there a while..."
clues.found: A Polaroid tucked into the railing. Little Shenton Lane at night, a round little car in your carport bay. The house lights are on.
clues.title: the Polaroid of the lane

clues.broadcast: "...The Esplanade. They ticketed me there once. March. Nineteen seventy-nine..."
clues.found: A parking ticket, soft with age: 14 March 1979, Fiat 500, The Esplanade, 2:40 am. The plate has been scratched out.
clues.title: the 1979 parking ticket

clues.broadcast: "...Riverside Drive. The lights come up off the water if you wait. I marked them all..."
clues.found: A page torn from a street directory. Pencil circles round Kings Park, the river, the end of Little Shenton Lane. Someone has written: they only show at night.
clues.title: the street directory page

clues.broadcast: "...Royal Street, East Perth. I kept the shed key separate. Somewhere safe. Somewhere I'd go back to..."
clues.found: A keyring with a paper tag: 15 LSL, SHED. The ring is empty.
clues.title: the empty keyring

clues.broadcast: "...Havelock Street. This is the last tape. If you're hearing it, you've been driving my roads..."
clues.found: Another cassette: NIGHT DRIVE 12, LAST. The handwriting is shakier than the first.
clues.title: the NIGHT DRIVE 12 tape

clues.broadcast: "...Little Shenton Lane. The far end, by the wall. Come home. It's waiting where I always parked..."
clues.found: On the bricks where the idling car is always gone by the time you get there: a small brass key, cold as anything. It fits the tag.
clues.title: the shed key

ending: Under the sheet: a card table, a cassette deck, and a home-made transmitter, its little red light still on.
The deck is running. The tape is labelled NIGHT DRIVE 13, in your handwriting.
On the wall, a street directory map. Every pin is somewhere you've driven at night.
The voice on the tape reads the streets in the order you drove them. Then: "Little Shenton Lane. Home." Then nothing.
You switch the transmitter off. The radio in the car still finds the station after midnight. It just doesn't say anything new.
